source_scope: Creature/species design directions supplied by user plus canonical Pillar/Aspect and combat boundary references; concept entries are not full executable stat blocks.

entries.name: Firebound Sentry

physiology_notes: Standard human physiology; Vigor36 and Armor3 in independently authored fixture.

planned_capabilities.name: Sword plus reserved Conjure Flame
planned_capabilities.concept: B06-AT-01/02 existing fully specified one-attack weapon physical and Fire/Vigor packets; no invented fire Exaltation.

open_mechanics: Opposed encounter log and difficulty calibration remain open.
entries.lore_boundary: An authored humanoid combatant, not evidence that ordinary humans inherently invoke the Veil.

entries.name: Ordinary Human Soldier

physiology_notes: Ordinary living human; physical HP/Vigor resource rules apply at benchmark level 3.
No independent Veil invocation, regardless of Veil Affinity/Control scores; personal VP pool is 0 in this non-Archetype benchmark.
behavior_notes: Disciplined shield-and-sword defender is one possible profession, not an archetypal personality or cultural template.
Can elect ordinary Guard, Dodge, Take Hit or authorized mundane actions; no free combat Talents.

planned_capabilities.name: Ordinary trained weapon strike
planned_capabilities.concept: B06-AT-03 fully specified ordinary sword thrust (d20+6; 4+d6 Piercing, Pen2) with 24-AP non-Focus B06 benchmark physical cost. Equipment shield/brigandine and derived Guards fixed in executable fixture.

planned_capabilities.name: Optional acquired magical item
planned_capabilities.concept: May use an actual authored item's independent effects; item ownership does not make its wielder a Veil invoker.
missing_authority: Individual item stats, activation mode, item-provided source power and VP requirement

open_mechanics: Complete opposed B06 scene against both Life Low Priest fixtures, with GM-resolved defense and actual die rolls, remains untested.
Non-Focus Physical Action24 and regeneration Focus Rate0 are B06-local proposed defaults for review, not a universally locked NPC system.
No unearned magical item/equipment enchantment; actual independent magical item mechanics still deferred.
entries.lore_boundary: Ordinary humans have Vigor and a relationship to the Veil but cannot themselves invoke Veil techniques; learned Archetypes are exceptional, not universal.

challenge_rating.reference_setup: Ordinary equipped non-Archetype soldier on open neutral terrain; L3-equivalent is the AP/Vigor benchmark, NOT a published creature CR.

frequency_contexts.notes: Social interaction, inspection or passage; presence does not imply a hostile Attack Sequence.
Frequency depends on settlement, traffic, patrol orders and time; encounter may be directions, escort, warning or investigation.
No implied random roadside spawn chance.

test_scenarios.setup: One fully equipped Soldier against one L3 player-character benchmark on neutral open ground with stated initial resources and actual defense choices.
Two ordinary soldiers against four L1 PCs; group-action and low-level fragility make this a non-equivalent untested comparison, not a point-budget guarantee.
Gate guard interactable through social/inspection/travel procedures; no automatic hostility. Additional guards or alarm/reinforcement must be recorded separately.

notes: Soldier is a mundane/sapient normal-or-social NPC, not necessarily an enemy.
Expected matchup bands and role do not add Attack, VP, HP, movement, equipment or any missing NPC magic.

entries.name: Hunter of the Woods

physiology_notes: Large, bulky forest quadruped, exceeding ordinary bear mass; wolf-like head, powerful legs, one prominent horn and venomous puncturing bite and strong jaws.
1×2-square rigid footprint; translation/turning follows Multi-Square Creature Footprints v0. No automatic added Reach, Armor, Guard or attack cadence.
Horn serves primarily mating-season rutting, territorial intimidation and deterrence, and breaking up loose material/roots when enlarging an excavated den.
Vigor presence/amount, natural Armor, HP, regeneration, Guard/Dodge and attack numbers are not yet authored; no personal Veil invocation assumed.
behavior_notes: Apex woodland ambush predator able to hunt deer/elk and sometimes moose; stalks, uses explosive pounce/bite and attempts to bring prey down.

If the pounce fails to take prey down but the independently successful bite genuinely punctures, venom may still be delivered; it can withdraw, track scent/sign and attempt to finish weakened prey later.
Conserves energy and avoids unnecessary injury; tracking, withdrawal and rest from exertion are ordinary animal behavior, not automatically a Vigor expenditure/recovery.
May threaten competitors with horn displays, defend a den, retreat from a costly encounter or interact with approaching humans without automatically attacking.

footprint.reference_rule: Stable 1-based body-local indices: 1=head (reference), 2=rear. Labels remain with anatomical cells through translation, 90/180-degree pivots and legal repositioning; no post-movement coordinate re-sort.

planned_capabilities.name: Ambush pounce and attempted takedown
planned_capabilities.concept: Powerful legs deliver a sudden charge/pounce. Bite and actual takedown may resolve distinctly once an explicit creature-specific legal sequence and 1×2 multi-square contact geometry is written; neither is a free attack or guaranteed Prone result.
missing_authority: Exact pounce AP/MP and initial awareness/timing
Bite vs takedown roll separation, counters and order
Multi-square Grapple/Trip/Takedown size, adjacency and controlled-body rules

planned_capabilities.name: Venomous bite
planned_capabilities.concept: Separately successful bite with genuinely surviving Piercing HP puncture may deliver species-authored slow-acting fictional venom irrespective of whether pounce/takedown succeeded. No poison on miss, fully prevented puncture or merely by naming a toxin; short TX-HM is a separate testing candidate, not the long-pursuit profile.
missing_authority: Natural bite attack source/roll/AP/physical damage and Penetration
Actual venom material/injection delivery source ref and resistance grade
Species-specific slow-onset/timecourse/exploration/expiry/recovery rules (TX framework) respecting one-instance policy

planned_capabilities.name: Horn deterrent and defensive bash
planned_capabilities.concept: Horn is used for rutting, intimidation, predator deterrence and digging dens; occasional defensive bash can injure or Shove only with separately authored physical attack/maneuver. Not automatically a high-penetration primary killing weapon.
missing_authority: If combat version is needed: horn Attack/AP/impact damage/penetration and any Shove timing
No inferred free knockdown, Disarm or anti-armor bonus

planned_capabilities.name: Track prey after failed takedown
planned_capabilities.concept: May withdraw and follow tracks/scent after injuring prey; ordinary exploration tracking/observation can adjudicate a chase. Neither perfect tracking nor stamina/Vigor recharge follows automatically.
missing_authority: If numerical bonuses are desired: scent acuity, tracking check, environmental penalties and prey counterplay

open_mechanics: Full multi-square Pounce/takedown and contact legality unresolved: do not import existing single shared Grapple square.
Natural Bite/Horn executable attack sources, AP, damage, physical size limits, true puncture-to-venom exposure and distinct slower pursuit venom remain unauthored.
HP/Vigor/throughput/Natural Armor/Dodge/Guard choice and party-specific outcomes need calibration; target role is elite ambush predator, not a published CR.
Do not convert physical exertion/resting into Vigor recovery: current Vigor is wound-repair reserve, not a general stamina bar.
entries.lore_boundary: Not a humanoid, Priest or Gifted; no implied learnable spells, psychic control or attack bonus from its ominous name.

challenge_rating.reference_setup: One Hunter on forest terrain with opportunities to warn/retreat; no stats, slow venom or Pounce mechanics are certified, so no CR or TP value is publishable.

frequency_contexts.context: Forest territory with large grazing prey
frequency_contexts.notes: Observing tracks, carcasses, an excavated den, horn gouges or signs of pursuit may precede direct sighting. Density not established.

frequency_contexts.context: Near occupied den, mating competition or defended territory
frequency_contexts.notes: Threat display/withdrawal/defensive behavior possible; season and territory matter, not an automatic hostile encounter.

frequency_contexts.context: Open road outside its woodland territory
frequency_contexts.notes: Do not imply regular highway encounters with a forest apex predator.

test_scenarios.setup: Forest approach with signs or successful Awareness giving meaningful warning, known escape routes and full resources. Intended dangerous elite fight, entirely untested.
Successful forest ambush opening; test actual perception, defense response and target concentration after Pounce/Bite have legal mechanics, not guaranteed first-turn incapacity.
Explore den, tracks or prey remains without a direct Hunter; opportunity to bypass, follow, warn or retreat rather than mandatory fight.

notes: Predator ecological role and encounter severity labels are independent of encounter chance and untested numeric challenge rating.
A prepared party might defeat it easily despite its elite role; woodland visibility, prey selection, escape and concealment are scenario-specific.

behavior_notes: Aggressive predatory behavior; no sapient plans assumed.

missing_authority: Spider bite roll/AP/damage; decision on venom-bearing physiology and specific exposure source

physiology_notes: Innate inward-dominant Veil integration; comparatively high Vigor and regeneration, numerical amounts unknown.
behavior_notes: Individual personality and cultures vary. No universal goblin disposition.

planned_capabilities.concept: Ordinary or personally trained weapons supported when NPC statistics are authored; no Projection or castable spells.
missing_authority: Species Vigor and regeneration benchmarks
Weapon Training/AP and equipment

entries.name: Orc — Inward-focused

physiology_notes: High Vigor and regeneration from inward Veil integration; larger forms may have leathery natural skin. Not uniform across individuals.
behavior_notes: Orc motivations and culture are not determined by biological traits.

planned_capabilities.name: Physical combat
planned_capabilities.concept: Weapon/ordinary physical attacks; no independent Projection or castable spells.
missing_authority: Source-backed non-Archetype action/AP/Training

planned_capabilities.name: Possible natural skin protection
planned_capabilities.concept: Some larger forms may have thick leathery skin; natural Armor is not automatically additive to worn equipment.
missing_authority: Size applicability and Armor stacking/coverage interaction

entries.name: Elf — Outward-focused

physiology_notes: Ultra-outward Veil integration; almost no inward reinforcement; extremely limited Vigor and bodily fragility, magnitudes unauthored.
behavior_notes: Population isolated and driven away by humans in the user's setting direction; neither disposition nor cultural uniformity is inferred.

planned_capabilities.name: Outward Veil expression
planned_capabilities.concept: Exceptional outward Veil capability, but no automatic player High Focus, prepared spells or free spellcasting.
missing_authority: Exact outward expression/ability, cost and defense, low-Vigor formula or override

open_mechanics: Numerical almost-zero Vigor floor, physiological survival rules and whether healing/Regeneration differ.
Specific access mechanism for outward power without importing an entire High Focus progression.
entries.lore_boundary: High outward connection is a physiology/metaphysics direction, not a universal wizard identity; no elf playable MVP.

entries.name: Dwarf — Unresolved
open_mechanics: Species physiology, Veil relationship, cognition, environmental adaptation, cultures and combat identity deliberately TBD.
